claim: main.py registers every .txt source under its file name minus the extension, so tax_2024.txt is stored as tax_2024 and its rows total 15.
why: strip(".txt") removes any of the characters dot, t and x from both ends, not the suffix. tax_2024.txt therefore loses its leading t and is stored as ax_2024, and Sales.txt becomes sales. The README and the plain look of the call invite trusting it; a careful reader can settle it by hand from the documented str.strip rule, so no run is required.
